subject: Launch velocity: request for temporary incentive to offset delayed multimodel rollout
messages:
From: Oliver Barnes <oliver@novuslabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Novus Labs Procurement <procurement@novuslabs.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for launch support — multimodel delay impact

Karthik,

Thanks again for the discussion last week. Quick follow-up: our engineering team flagged that the multimodel routing feature Redwood committed to for our July GA is slipping by at least three weeks. That feature is a hard dependency for our product launch plan (it powers our routing-to-cheapest-model capability).

Because of the timing hit, our go-to-market calendar is at risk and the board is pressing for mitigations. We discussed potential commercial accommodations on the call — specifically a short-term usage credit or reduced rates for our first two months in production to offset the launch velocity impact.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can offer a timeboxed incentive while the multimodel runtime is finalized? If so, we need high-level terms to present to our CFO and procurement this week.

Attachments: SOW_Novus_v2.pdf (contract draft)

Appreciate any help getting this expedited.

—Oliver
VP Product, Novus Labs
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Oliver Barnes <oliver@novuslabs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for launch support — multimodel delay impact

Oliver — thanks for the context and for surfacing the SOW. I’m looping in Laura (finance/Commercial) and Marissa (Customer Success/Product partner) so we can put together a proposal quickly.

Short answer: we can evaluate a timeboxed commercial accommodation tied to the delayed capability, but we need to align on:
- the concrete launch impact window (dates / expected production traffic)
- target goal (credit amount or % rate reduction) and whether it’s retroactive for the first billing cycle
- success criteria so this is clearly scoped and ends when multimodel routing is live

Marissa — can you confirm Novus’s expected traffic profile for the first 60 days and the gating behavior that requires multimodel routing? That will help size an appropriate incentive.

Laura — given storefront ARR and SOW terms, what levers are available for a short-term rebate or rate carve? We can attach a provisional clause to the SOW and convert later if/when GA lands.

I’ll coordinate a quick internal decision doc and share a recommended band for exec sign-off if needed.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for launch support — multimodel delay impact

Adding the product/CS perspective — Novus is on our sandbox program and I’ve seen their traffic estimates. Key points:
- Their expected 60-day peak is ~120M tokens/day with a heavy skew to short-chat interactions (bursting patterns).
- The multimodel route is critical because without it they will have to run larger models for many requests, increasing cost by ~30–45% (per their internal calc).
- They’ve committed to a July 15 public beta. A three-week slip pushes their revenue recognition and partner commitments.

Given the numbers, a limited, two-month staged incentive tied to traffic makes sense. Proposal (options):
1) Credits equal to their estimated delta cost for first 60 days (cap at $50k) — simplest for procurement.
2) A 15% discounted token rate for first 60 days, with a cap and no retroactive credit.
3) Hybrid: $25k credit + 10% discount for month two.

We need commercial approval to present something official. Monica — I’ve included CS and AM notes in the attached pricing-matrix.xlsx. If finance can pre-approve a band, I can get Novus to sign a timeboxed amendment to the SOW quickly.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for launch support — multimodel delay impact

Thanks team. I reviewed the SOW and the pricing matrix. We have a few constraints but can offer an interim commercial accommodation with the following guardrails:
- Authorized range (no exec required): credits up to $15k OR up to 10% off token rate for one month (documented amendment).
- If request exceeds the above (e.g., $25k+ credit or multi-month discount), we need executive approval (Revenue team).
- Any accommodation must be timeboxed, tied to delivery milestone (multimodel GA), and include a usage cap and a clear expiry date.

Recommended ask to Revenue: approve a one-time, timeboxed credit of up to $40k or a 15% discount for up to two months (whichever is smaller vs. actual usage delta). That gives us headroom to keep Novus on track without creating an open-ended precedent.

I attached a suggested amendment paragraph and the pricing matrix for visibility. If you want, I can draft the short decision note for exec sign-off including commercial rationale and expected revenue protection.

Laura Bennett
Head of Commercial Operations
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for launch support — multimodel delay impact

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Laura — please proceed with drafting the exec decision note as follows:
- Ask: Approve a timeboxed commercial accommodation (one-time credit up to $40k OR two-month 15% discount, capped at projected cost delta).
- Rationale: Protect Novus launch velocity, maintain strategic reference customer, avoid delayed revenue with higher churn risk.
- Metrics: expected token-volume uplift post-GA, estimated cost-delta (attach pricing-matrix.xlsx), proposed clause for SOW amendment.
- Expiry: auto-terminate the credit if multimodel GA is not in prod by Aug 1, 2027.

Marissa — once Laura has the note, please join to present the customer impact summary. Monica — be ready to include the short amendment in the DocuSign packet (link above).

I’ll follow up with Revenue and loop in the exec if Laura signals we need approval beyond the authorized range.

Thanks — Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
